_notes:
Measure the near/mid-garden shrubs and herbaceous plants from the splat cloud -> data/params/shrubs.json.

python3 scripts/analyze_shrubs.py [--debug]

Method (numpy/scipy only, world metres, Z up):
1. Opaque splats (A > 100) within the shrub zone (r <= R_MAX around the table, minus the boundary strips owned by the
   BOUNDARY part and the TREE part's trunk column).
2. Local ground: per 0.25 m cell the 3rd-percentile Z, then a 1 m minimum filter + median (cells hidden under a
   shrub take the lowest neighbouring ground), clipped to a sane range.
3. Vegetation splats: green-dominant colour (G > 1.02 R, G > 1.15 B) and height above ground in (H_MIN, H_MAX).
4. 0.2 m voxel occupancy (>= 3 splats), one closing step, 3D connected components; small components dropped.
   Components wider than ~1.6 m are split into ~1.2 m pieces by k-means on XY so each envelope is a convex mound.
5. Per piece: centre, PCA yaw, 5..95 % extents along the two XY axes, ground Z, 95 % height, mean/std colour
   (sRGB), splat elongation (largest/middle scale) and the verticality of the long axis -> leaf type guess:
   'strap' (elongated, upright splats: iris/grass-like blades), 'broadleaf' (dark mound), 'bright' (yellow-green).
6. Kinds, in order: low (top < 0.32 m), strap (upright-splat share > 0.16, top < 1 m), herb (top < 0.6 m, the
   low herbaceous layer), bright (yellow-green, fill >= 4000), sparse (fill < 12000 splats/m^3), else broadleaf.
   Sparse pieces with fill < 4000 or taller than 1.8 m (canes in pots, overhead crown fringes) go to 'dropped'.
7. Extra lists: bed weeds (green splats 3..45 cm above bare soil/paving cells, >= 25 splats, >= 9 cm tall) in
   'weeds'; pond iris/grass clumps (upright elongated splats, y 3.6..5.3) appended to 'shrubs' as strap pieces.

Uncertainty: splat centres sit ~on the visible foliage surface, so envelopes are outer shells; interiors and the
back sides of shrubs facing the boundary are poorly observed (few cameras). Heights are +-0.1 m; extents +-0.15 m.

Zone r<=5.2 m, boundary strips x>4.55, y>4.2, x<-5.0 excluded. Vegetation splats used: 184647. 'centre' = XY of the envelope (4..96 % box centre), 'radii' = half extents along yaw / yaw+90deg, 'height' = 95 % height above ground_z. color_srgb = mean SH-DC colour (includes overcast lighting, not albedo).

density_field.note: x, y, z, normalized density; see density_field() in scripts/analyze_shrubs.py
